articles.availability_note: The November 13 Dublin meeting was an informal European Council strategic discussion. Official accounts establish guests and themes, without a verbatim record of their contributions. The November 3 steering note sets questions, not adopted decisions. Future budget instruments, adoption, oversight and February/2027 summit plans remain distinct from funded programmes, binding new law or measured economic effects.
